Your exploratory data analysis of the team datasets go here.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(Lock5Data)
data(GSWarriors2016)


```

```{r}
GSWarriors2016 |> 
  tabyl(Win)
```
```{r}
GSWarriors2016 |>
     tabyl(Location, Win)
```
```{r}
GSWarriors2016 |>
    tabyl(Opp, Win) |>
    adorn_totals(c("row", "col")) |>
    arrange(desc(W))
```
```{r}
GSWarriors2016 |>
    filter(Date == "1/11/2016") |>
    tabyl(Opp, Win, Date,  show_missing_levels = FALSE) 
```
